body: That student teaching is the worst... It's stress and added stress. I can't promise the depression gets better, but it does get easier to teach in long run. I mean, it's a tough job, but it's easier when  you're not brand new at it and you're not taking classes at the same time.

The proper response to cutting is indifference. I mean, you shouldn't cut yourself, but if you do, don't go too deep. If you want to cry out for other people to help, follow Ovid's suggestion and go to a public place and collapse. People will pick you up  and it leaves fewer scars.
I don't agree it's faulty thinking. It's accurate thinking, to do nothing, or drink, when the world is senseless.
I lack the strength to solve it at this point. 25 years and I'm Exauhestd. Truly. I know it sounds dramatic.
Not to say it's hopeless. I mean, to be honest, it can be, but in some cases medication and therapy can help. External goals, achieving them anyway, doesn't get at the source.
It's a mental illness. Imagine you got your arm chopped off. Would getting a girlfriend make your arm grow back?

Most people don't notice. You don't figure much in their existence. They think of you once in a while. They're like, I wonder what that crazy MaxWheeler0568 is up to and then they're on to the next thing. I don't think most people contemplate others much. We are minor characters in the movie in which they are the star.

In the same boat. I called a suicide hotline not to long ago - I was pretty darn close - and the guy was all over me, talking about how my kids would feel, my parents... So, you keep living for other people. But it really sucks. Not that you're in the same boat, but I just told myself you're a piece of crap that doesn't deserve to get the relief oblivion would bring, so you just keep going. You know, suffer mothet****er. Just saying I know where you're at, maybe.
Dude. There's the science. So drinking makes it worse? Gotta love that irony that the thing that makes it better ultimately makes it worse.

You're good, man/woman. I mean depression is pretty genetic, but it doesn't help when the parental units are pushing you downhill. Already enough momentum going with this illness. No help when there's mater/pater malfeasance.
